messages:
marta: deploybot flagged an anomaly during v3.7.2 canary deploy, text-gen p95 jumped to ~460ms for the eu-dedicated pool

deploybot: auto-safety: limit applied (50% throttle) at 4135678901. alert_id=DB-SAFETY-524

marta: recommending a hold. auto-rollback is enabled but EU-dedicated pools are pinned; we need operator action to revert

jon: what signals tripped? p95 only or also errors/kv?
deploybot: signals: p95 > 360ms sustained for 6m, 5xx +0.4% absolute, kv-cache hit ratio -9%. auto-rollback configured to require ack for pinned pools

rachel: i'd prefer manual revert so we can capture traces. sounds like a kernel quantization tweak may be the culprit in this build

marta: agree. @jon you run the revert steps, @rachel handle comms and release note update

jon: plan: 1) pin eu-dedicated to v3.7.1 2) execute revert 3) monitor 10m 4) escalate if metrics don't recover

jon: pin command (dry run):
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --pool eu-dedicated --model v3.7.1 --reason "p95 regression v3.7.2"
```

ops-bot: Incident INC-20241201-524 created, owner=jon, severity=low-med, eta_action=4135678920

jon: pin complete at 4135678924. starting revert now

deploybot: revert initiated, progress 30% traffic shifted back to v3.7.1

rachel: release notes updated: "Reverted v3.7.2 due to p95 regression on text-gen route for eu-dedicated; investigating kernel/quantize interaction. RCA pending."

deploybot: revert complete at 4135678958. canary stable on v3.7.1. summary: p95 ~190ms, 5xx baseline restored, kv-hit recovered

marta: good. next actions: create PM ticket, add regression eval set, and consider temporary tighter auto-rollback thresholds for kv-sensitive canaries

rachel: PM-20241201-524 created and assigned to runtime + s-research. customer notification sent to affected accounts (template rollback-eu-1)

jon: I'll add the revert commands and telemetry capture steps to the runbook and attach logs

sam: :thumbsup:

marta: thanks team. closing thread at 4135678960
